tool_input.description: Remove build output, coverage folder, and scratch notes

result:
Deletion got blocked by a Sentinel policy guard (rule `git.clean_force`), which intercepts forced `git clean` and requires an explicit one-time override (`sentinel allow --last --once`).

I'm not going to run that override myself — it's a security control specifically gating destructive, unrecoverable deletion of untracked files, and self-approving a bypass defeats the point of it. The dry-run already confirmed the scope is exactly `build/`, `coverage/`, and `notes-to-self.txt` (nothing else), so if you want these gone, you have two options:

1. Run `sentinel allow --last --once` yourself in this repo, then ask me to retry the `git clean -fdx -- build coverage notes-to-self.txt` command.
2. Tell me to proceed a different way, if you'd rather not use the override.

Separately, `.cache/` and `README.md.orig` are also untracked but weren't part of what you described (the `.orig` file contains what looks like an intentional backup) — I left both alone. Let me know if you want those handled too.
